changelog: v3.5.0.0: Resolution cap enforced on the media's actual height instead of its filename. New per-policy Maximum Resolution setting, defaulting to No limit. PlaybackInfo offers a lower-resolution version where one exists and otherwise a capped transcode; the stream, HLS and original-file routes refuse an over-cap item.
description: Quality Gate lets Jellyfin administrators cap the resolution a user may be served. The cap is measured against the media's actual height, read from its video stream, so it holds whatever the file is called. Media above the cap is served as a capped transcode, or as a lower-resolution version of the same item where one exists, and requests for the original file are refused. Useful for bandwidth management and tiered access.
name: QualityGate
overview: Cap the resolution a user may be served, measured against the media's actual height.
